Topics covered in this PDF

MPS-106 (Political Theory: Contemporary Debates) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • Communitarianism, Libertarianism and Nozick's entitlement theory, Kymlicka and Parekh on multiculturalism, Cosmopolitanism
  • Secularism, fundamentalism, hegemony in Marxism and Post-Marxism, economic determinism, Lukacs and Gramsci, recognition as justice, public-private divide, patriarchy

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.
